name: Curse of Polymorphing
description:
While digging, this tool randomly changes which block set it is effective against.

  • [term:curse][red]Curse Spell[/red][/term]: [dark-red]Sacrifice 2.5❤️[/dark-red] to morph into a Deep One for 30 seconds, during which all punches are [term:corrupt][dark-gray]corrupted[/dark-gray][/term].
